name: Death Of The Wicked The
overview: The death of the wicked is portrayed in Scripture as a consequence of persistent rebellion and hardness of heart against God, as seen in the example of Zedekiah who refused to humble himself despite clear warnings. Their end is frequently marked by terror and sudden destruction, with imagery of their strength being devoured and their lives filled with fear on every side. This sobering reality underscores that such death occurs in their sins, without hope, and is a just punishment for their evil deeds.
